skills.description_zh: 通过定期提取帧来分析视频内容。适用于理解视频文件内容、审查视频、分析场景或描述视频。支持MP4、MOV、AVI、MKV等常见视频格式。
skills.name: Video-Watch

skills.description: Add causal reasoning to agent actions. Trigger on ANY high-level action with observable outcomes - emails, messages, calendar changes, file operations, API calls, notifications, reminders, purchases, deployments. Use for planning interventions, debugging failures, predicting outcomes, backfilling historical data for analysis, or answering "what happens if I do X?" Also trigger when reviewing past actions to understand what worked/failed and why.
skills.description_zh: 为智能体行为增加因果推理能力。触发条件为任何具有可观察结果的高级行为，如邮件、消息、日历变更、文件操作、API调用、通知、提醒、购买或部署。用于规划干预、调试故障、预测结果、回填历史数据以供分析，或解答“如果我执行X会发生什么”。亦在复盘过往行为以理解成败原因时触发。
skills.name: Causal Inference
